scope: Local opt-in browser timings. Render callbacks are not GPU time or headset FPS. Worker delivery measures wall-time between snapshots, not simulation CPU cost. No actions, identifiers, text, URLs or hidden sensor truth are recorded.
limitations: CPU, resource and frame timings are correlated evidence, not automatic causal attribution.
Background frames are excluded; gaps and dropped samples are disclosed.
Compare fixed viewport, hardware, quality, roster, warm state and workload; median alone is insufficient.
